title: The richest man alive got his grandson's ear in the mail. He still haggled 👂
caption:
J. Paul Getty. Richest man in the world. Cheapest too. 💰
Tag the friend who splits the bill to the penny 😤
first_comment: Tag the friend who'd negotiate too 👇
sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'J. Paul Getty' (richest private citizen; Sutton Place)

Pearson J. (1995) 'Painfully Rich: The Outrageous Fortunes and Misfortunes of the Heirs of J. Paul Getty' (pay phone at Sutton Place; 'fourteen grandchildren' quote; ransom about $2.9M, $2.2M tax-deductible, rest lent to his son at 4%)
The New York Times (1973-74) coverage of the kidnapping of John Paul Getty III (ear sent to Il Messaggero, November 1973)
